items.exampleTranslation: This is a traditional bigilla recipe.

items.example: Servi l-bigilla sħuna jew kiesħa, bil-galletti jew bil-ħobż tal-Malti frisk.
items.exampleTranslation: Serve the bigilla hot or cold with water biscuits or fresh Maltese bread.
Read the list of ingredients.
Preparation starts by soaking the beans.

items.english: half a kilo of dried tic beans
items.example: Uża nofs kilo ful tal-ġirba niexef.
items.exampleTranslation: Use half a kilo of dried tic beans.
Add a tablespoon of chopped parsley.
Add a little Tabasco.
Add five cloves of grated garlic.

items.english: the juice of half a lemon
items.exampleTranslation: Use the juice of half a lemon.
Add four tablespoons of olive oil.

items.example: Ferra' ġo skutella u raxxax il-frak tal-felfel fil-wiċċ.
items.exampleTranslation: Pour into a bowl and sprinkle the chilli flakes on top.
Use dried, crushed chilli.
Add salt to taste.
The quantities can be adjusted to taste.

items.example: Xarrab il-ful bl-ilma u ħallieh jixxarrab għal 24 (erbgħa u għoxrin) siegħa.
items.exampleTranslation: Cover the beans with water and leave them to soak for twenty-four hours.

items.example: Sajjar fil-pressure cooker għal madwar 20 (għoxrin) minuta, jew ġo borma għal madwar siegħa u nofs jew sakemm il-ful ikun irtab.
items.exampleTranslation: Cook in a pressure cooker for about twenty minutes, or in a pot for about an hour and a half or until the beans have softened.
